confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or city price pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is quoted in USD and varies by season and property. July is peak safari season, so accommodation anchors reflect high-season pricing. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange rates page and was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against East African safari-gateway towns, mainly Nairobi's tourist districts and Moshi, with prices adjusted for Tanzanian price levels and a tourist-facing USD-anchored market.
